title: Cursive Handwriting Workbook Printable, Grade 1 2 Sight Words Math Practice PDF, Kids Cursive Tracing, GoodNotes iPad, Instant Download
description:
🐚 The step-up workbook for kids who've outgrown basic tracing — real cursive-style handwriting, harder sight words, sentence writing, and math with regrouping, built for ages 6-8 (1st-2nd grade).

Meet the Cursive & Skills Workbook (Ocean Breeze) — the older-kids sibling of our original tracing workbook line. 48 pages that step up in every direction at once: cursive-style letters instead of print, a genuinely harder sight-word tier, full sentences to trace and copy, and real 2-digit addition/subtraction with regrouping plus multiplication facts.

⚠️ A note on the cursive style: these are clean, fully-joined cursive-style letterforms, genuinely traceable and legible for a 6-8 year old — not a copy of a specific school district's official D'Nealian or Zaner-Bloser penmanship standard. If your child's classroom teaches a specific cursive curriculum, use this as extra practice alongside it, not a replacement for it.
